facts.fact: The World Bank review says the social registry is linked to the national ID system (OMANG) for validation; no date is given for the link, so the document's published date (2022) is used.
The World Bank review says beneficiary data for at least five programmes was digitised into the social registry in four districts and uploaded in six districts by May 2021.
